findings.affected_population_system: WAFA reports Ahmad Ashraf Sihyoun, 27, killed and several other Palestinians injured in a Saturday strike affecting a residential property. Civilian status, exact injury count and severity, and extent of damage not established.

bounded_discovery_context.method: Targeted WAFA casualty search, WAFA homepage and direct updated article inspection; compared against 15 authenticated prior heartbeats from November 27 12:44 through November 28 02:44.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: New to reviewed ledger; Saturday residential strike distinct as described from Friday Al-Rimal incident and Saturday Khan Younis child injury. Search index displayed an earlier injuries-only headline, while direct article contains fatality update; record once.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Publisher displays November 28 12:34 PM without explicit timezone (02:34 Pacific if Palestine local time); this would precede prior cutoff by about ten minutes. Update time is unknown. Newly discovered within this window, not proven first published in it. Independent corroboration and production comparison unavailable.
